thread:
omar_q: hey team, onboarding day! enrolled my MacBook Pro into Jamf successfully but when i enabled FileVault it said 'Recovery key escrow failed'. fdesetup shows FileVault On though. worried my recovery key isn't backed up. anyone seen this? :thinking:
it_helpdesk: welcome @omar_q :wave: we should confirm the device record in the MDM. can you share the serial and the enrollment ID shown in System Settings -> Profiles?
omar_q: serial C02L9X2M4AB7, enrollment id: enroll-87a3c
it_helpdesk: thanks. i'm checking the console — looks like MDM attempted to escrow but our KMS returned 502 for that request window. @kms_bot can you surface recent escrow errors for that serial?
kms_bot: Escrow check: serial C02L9X2M4AB7 -> last attempt 2026-03-20T09:12:15Z -> status: KMS 502 Bad Gateway. Correlation ID 9f3b2d. See internal dashboard: https://kms.redwood.internal/errors/9f3b2d
lev_sre: we had a transient issue between the MDM and KMS earlier due to a cert rotate. it should be resolved now. @it_helpdesk please re-run the escrow push from Jamf.
it_helpdesk: re-pushing escrow now. ops job 8844 -> push/fv-escrow -> target C02L9X2M4AB7. status queued.
kms_bot: Escrow job 8844 executed -> result: success. Recovery key Escrowed to KMS.
omar_q: confirmed i got the prompt that the recovery key was saved. phew. thanks. quick follow-up: i had to accept a number of privacy prompts (Screen Recording, Full Disk Access) for Docker/Zoom. is there a way to request entitlements centrally?
it_helpdesk: entitlements are handled case-by-case. for common apps like Docker and Zoom we have pre-approved profiles. ping #it-help with the app name and reason and include your device serial. we'll push the config.
sophie_pm: welcome aboard @omar_q! glad that was sorted fast. FYI we keep an onboarding checklist in Notion and a small loaner policy if anything hardware-y blocks you.
omar_q: awesome — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
